title: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(2)
desc: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(2)

paragraphs.en: Inside one of the Guchi Robotics warehouses, a team of employees from General Motors was testing Guchi's wheel-installation machines ahead of a shipment to Canada.
paragraphs.zh: 在固智机器人的一间仓库内，通用汽车的一组工程师正在调试固智的车轮装配设备，这批设备即将发往加拿大工厂。

paragraphs.en: The hull of a white GM truck occupied a raised platform at the centre of the room.
paragraphs.zh: 车间中央的升降平台上摆放着一台白色通用卡车车身。

paragraphs.en: The truck, surrounded by four large robotic arms and a jungle of wires, sat inside a yellow safety enclosure made of steel bars.
paragraphs.zh: 车身四周架设四台大型机械臂，密密麻麻的管线缠绕其间，整套设备被钢制护栏围成黄色安全防护区。

paragraphs.en: I watched on the sidelines as a bearded GM engineer tinkered with a control panel outside the steel cage.
paragraphs.zh: 我站在一旁观望，一名留着胡须的通用工程师在护栏外侧的控制面板上调试参数。

paragraphs.en: The engineer, an American man whom I'll call Jack, worked in GM's "manufacturing optimisation" division.
paragraphs.zh: 这位工程师是美国人，我称他为杰克，任职于通用汽车制造优化部门。

paragraphs.en: "To be grim, anything that eliminates people from the production line is basically my job," Jack told me.
paragraphs.zh: “说得直白点，我的工作核心就是想方设法削减生产线人力。”杰克向我说道。

paragraphs.en: General Motors sets job-reduction targets for his division each year, he said, which requires eliminating a set number of factory workers across all plants in North America.
paragraphs.zh: 他表示，通用汽车每年都会给该部门下达减员指标，要求北美所有工厂合计削减固定数量的一线装配工人。

paragraphs.en: His team chose Guchi over a German-based competitor – itself 95% owned by a Chinese company – because the other couldn't offer a moving assembly line, Jack explained.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克解释，团队最终选择固智，而非一家总部位于德国、但九成五股权归属中国企业的竞品厂商，原因是对方无法提供适配动态输送流水线的设备方案。

paragraphs.en: The purchase of the Guchi machines, he said, would eliminate 12 assembly operators on the line at a single factory.
paragraphs.zh: 他称，采购这套固智设备后，单家工厂的装配线就能削减十二名装配操作工。

paragraphs.en: (General Motors did not confirm the job-reduction targets, but a spokesperson said it implements technology to help improve safety, efficiency and quality, "particularly for physically demanding or repetitive tasks.")
paragraphs.zh: （通用汽车官方并未确认减员指标，但一名发言人表示，企业引入自动化技术，旨在提升生产安全、生产效率与产品品质，“尤其针对高强度、重复性的人工工序”。）

paragraphs.en: An irony of the Trump administration's mission to revive industrial production within the US is that much of the machinery required to make America great again comes from the country that motivated America's industrial revival in the first place.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普政府曾力推美国本土制造业回流，这件事颇具讽刺意味：大量助力美国重振制造业的自动化设备，恰恰产自当初促使美国启动制造业振兴计划的中国。

paragraphs.en: China now accounts for more than half of the world's new factory robot installations annually.
paragraphs.zh: 如今中国每年新增工业机器人装机量占全球总量的一半以上。

paragraphs.en: Chen thinks Chinese and American engineers are comparable in skill and talent.
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮认为中美两国工程师的专业能力不相上下。

paragraphs.en: "The difference is really just cost and speed, and how many people you can throw at a problem – we might have 1,000 who can do this work, and they might have 100," he said.
paragraphs.zh: “二者真正的差距只在于成本、研发速度，以及可投入项目的人力规模——我们这边或许有一千名能胜任这项工作的技术人员，而美方可能只有一百人。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: Chen and I walked to the end of the warehouse, where we now had a frontal view of the GM truck.
paragraphs.zh: 我和陈亮走到仓库尽头，在这里可以直面那台通用卡车车身。

paragraphs.en: After watching Jack work for a bit, Chen pointed me to the robotic arms on each side of the car body: "You see those?
paragraphs.zh: 旁观杰克调试设备片刻后，陈亮指向车身两侧的机械臂说道：“你看那些设备。

paragraphs.en: This is the screwdriving robot.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是自动拧螺丝机器人。

paragraphs.en: Even if manufacturing does come back to North America, they won't be putting workers on the line to fasten screws any more. They'll use robots."
paragraphs.zh: 就算制造业生产线真的回流北美，工厂也不会再安排工人在线上拧螺丝，全部都会改用机器人操作。”

paragraphs.en: I wasn't so sure. Wasn't one reason that Americans elected Trump because they wanted their blue-collar jobs back?
paragraphs.zh: 我对此并不十分认同。当初美国民众投票支持特朗普，不就是希望夺回蓝领工作岗位吗？

paragraphs.en: Chen thought this was pure illusion. The world had changed, and so had young people.
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮认为这种想法纯属空想。时代已经变了，年轻人的观念也截然不同。

paragraphs.en: Chen told me to think about China, where factory culture is deeply ingrained but young Chinese are increasingly reluctant to tolerate the drudgery.
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮让我换位思考看看中国，这里工厂产业文化根基深厚，但年轻一代越来越不愿忍受枯燥繁重的流水线劳作。

paragraphs.en: "It's just how people are wired now."
paragraphs.zh: “现在人的想法本就如此。”

paragraphs.en: If even Chinese people aren't willing to do factory work any more, Chen was saying, why would Americans?
paragraphs.zh: 陈亮的言外之意是，如果连中国人都不愿进厂做工，美国人又怎么会愿意？

paragraphs.en: One week after my visit to Guchi HQ, I met Chen in north-west Beijing, where the city's top universities are located.
paragraphs.zh: 拜访固智总部一周后，我在北京西北部高校聚集区见到了陈亮。

paragraphs.en: He had invited me to a meeting at the head office of Galbot, one of China's most hyped humanoid robotics startups.
paragraphs.zh: 他邀请我前往嘉博特机器人总部参加一场会议，这家企业是国内热度极高的人形机器人初创公司。

paragraphs.en: One of its wheeled humanoids appeared in a skit at this year's lunar new year jamboree, where it handed a male actor a bottle of water from a shelf and folded laundry.
paragraphs.zh: 该公司一款带轮人形机器人登上了今年春晚小品舞台，它从货架上为男演员递矿泉水，还演示了叠衣服。

paragraphs.en: Since its founding in 2023, Galbot has pursued a less showy strategy than many of its competitors: building robots that can perform mundane tasks such as picking up items and setting them down elsewhere safely and reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 嘉博特2023年成立，相比许多同行，它走的路线更为务实低调：研发能够完成基础重复工作的机器人，稳定、精准地完成物品拾取、搬运放置等操作。

paragraphs.en: The founder, Wang He, told a Chinese reporter recently that their robots are already deployed in several Chinese car factories, though videos appear to show them in highly controlled settings.
paragraphs.zh: 公司创始人王贺近期接受国内媒体采访时称，自家机器人已经落地国内多家车企厂区，不过相关实拍视频显示，设备均运行在高度标准化的受控环境内。

paragraphs.en: Galbot's "pick-and-place" robots might seem a lot dumber than their backflipping rivals, but a crucial difference is that the robot acrobats operate according to pre-programmed instructions: they are feats of motion control and balance, but they do not go off-script.
paragraphs.zh: 嘉博特的搬运机器人看起来远不如那些会后空翻的竞品机器人花哨，但二者存在一个关键区别：那些杂技机器人完全按照预设程序运行，只是运动控制与平衡技术的展示，无法脱离既定脚本自主行动。

paragraphs.en: The kind of technology being developed at Galbot is what roboticists call a vision-language-action model (VLA), which aims to allow machines to operate in unfamiliar and fluid environments, just as humans do.
paragraphs.zh: 嘉博特研发的核心技术，是机器人领域所说的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），目标是让机器像人类一样，在陌生、多变的真实环境中自主作业。

paragraphs.en: For now, Galbot's robots cannot reliably do what, for humans, would be trivial tasks – say, washing the dishes – but Wang, has told Chinese reporters he aims to have 10,000 robots handling basic retail and factory work in three years.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，嘉博特的机器人仍无法稳定完成对人类而言十分简单的家务，比如洗碗，但王贺向媒体表示，计划三年内投放一万台机器人，负责零售、工厂基础作业。

paragraphs.en: (Some AI pioneers, such as Yann LeCun, are extremely sceptical that the current paradigm of deep learning will deliver the results companies such as Galbot hope for.)
paragraphs.zh: （扬·勒丘恩等部分人工智能先驱对此持高度怀疑态度，他们认为当下的深度学习技术框架，很难实现嘉博特这类企业所期待的效果。）
